messages:
lee (Sales Eng): Heads up — BankProspect asked for a compact IAM bundle for the POC: SSO metadata (entityID + ACS), MFA statement, RBAC CSV for demo roles, and example machine/service-account practice. They want a single ZIP link. Can we assemble by noon?

noah (Solutions Eng): I can assemble the technical bits. Will include a sanitized SP metadata and an example SAML <Response> snippet (no user PII). Also will add a sample role-binding snippet for our API gateway.

emily (AE): They asked if admin users require hardware MFA or if Okta TOTP is fine for now. Need exact phrasing for the SIG question.

priya (Security): For production we require hardware-backed MFA for admin-level accounts (FIDO2 or YubiKey). For standard interactive users TOTP via Okta is acceptable. Policy blurb below you can paste: 

```
MFA Policy (excerpt):
- admin_role: REQUIRED (FIDO2/YubiKey)
- interactive_user: REQUIRED (Okta TOTP or device MFA)
- machine_principals: EPHEMERAL_TOKENS (12h TTL), rotated automatically
- audit: all auth events -> SIEM (365d retention)
```

lee (Sales Eng): Perfect. The buyer also needs a short sentence explaining service-account/automation access — they want to know if those bypass MFA.

priya (Security): Short answer: machine/service accounts do not use interactive MFA. They authenticate using ephemeral tokens or signed JWTs with enforced rotation and least-privilege scopes. I'll add one-line text they can copy.

noah (Solutions Eng): SAML snippet for them to validate metadata endpoints: 

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sso.redwood.ai/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs/demo" index="1"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

emily (AE): Nice. Can you also include a 2-line CSV for demo roles we give to POC users? They want to upload to their identity system for testing.

noah (Solutions Eng): CSV sample: 
role,scope,notes
poc_readonly,models:read;metrics:read,view-only POC role (expires 7d)
poc_engineer,models:invoke;prompts:create,can deploy demo prompts (expires 7d)

priya (Security): Add note that POC accounts are time-limited and scoped. For production we require SCIM provisioning + JIT role mapping. I'll draft a 1-paragraph statement about provisioning + audit trail and sign it.

lee (Sales Eng): Great — plan: Noah zips sanitized metadata + CSV + role-binding example; Priya drafts signed statement and screenshot of MFA settings; Emily will deliver to buyer and include link to the ZIP. ETA: 12:00 PST.

noah (Solutions Eng): Uploaded artifacts to internal bucket: https://files.redwood.ai/poc/bankprospect/iam-bundle-177912.zip (sanitized).

priya (Security): Uploaded signed statement PDF to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/POC-BANK-1779. Statement includes: "Hardware MFA for admins; TOTP for standard users; machine principals use ephemeral 12h tokens; RBAC enforced and logged."

doc-bot: Shared artifact link (https://files.redwood.ai/poc/bankprospect/iam-bundle-177912.zip) and created ticket RED-2991 for record-keeping.

emily (AE): Sending now. I'll paste the MFA excerpt and the SAML snippet into the SIG form and attach the ZIP. If they come back asking for ATO evidence we'll route to Priya.

lee (Sales Eng): Thanks team :thumbsup: If buyer needs the ACS endpoint to be changed for their test tenant, we can generate a tenant-scoped ACS URL quickly — tag me and I'll spin one up.

priya (Security): FYI for the record: we do NOT grant persistent long-lived API keys to customer-managed POC users. Machine tokens are issued with constrained scopes and automated expiry.

emily (AE): Noted. Closing thread after delivery.
